## `ew lib create`

```text
ew lib create [--key <key>] [--name <name>] [--licence <licence>] [--company <company>]... [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--key` | yes | no |
| `--name` | yes | no |
| `--licence` | yes | no |
| `--company` | yes | yes |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 2 | usage, open, I/O and every other error |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.lib-create-result/1`, schema [`ew.lib-create-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.lib-create-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.lib-create-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `dir` | string | yes |  | Its directory. |
| `id` | string | yes |  | The new library's ID. |
| `key` | string | yes |  | The new library's key. |
| `listed` | boolean | yes |  | Whether it lies in a library tier (else pass it as `--company`). |

## `ew lib import parts`

```text
ew lib import parts [--map <map>] [--as-of <as-of>] [--bump] [--take-over] [--company <company>]... [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--map` | yes | no |
| `--as-of` | yes | no |
| `--bump` | no | no |
| `--take-over` | no | no |
| `--company` | yes | yes |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 2 | usage, open, I/O and every other error |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.lib-import-parts-result/1`, schema [`ew.lib-import-parts-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.lib-import-parts-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.lib-import-parts-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `library` | string | yes |  | The target library's key. |
| `report` | array of [`ReportRow`](#reportrow) | yes |  | The report, one entry per finding. |
| `rows` | [`RowCounts`](#rowcounts) | yes |  | The row counts. |
| `source` | string | yes |  | The table's name. |
| `written` | [`LibWrite`](#libwrite) or `null` | no |  | What the library write did; `null` when there was nothing to write. |

### LibWrite

The library write of `LibImportPartsResult`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `added` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Items new to the library. |
| `generation` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) | yes |  | The library's generation after the write. |
| `unchanged` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Items unchanged. |
| `updated` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Items written at a new version. |

### ReportRow

One finding of a mapped parts import.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes |  | The finding code (`EW-IMP-002`). |
| `line` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | The table line, where the finding has one. |
| `message` | string | yes |  | The message. |
| `severity` | [`ReportSeverity`](#reportseverity) | yes |  | The severity. |

### ReportSeverity

The severity of a `ReportRow`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"info"` | Info. |
| `"warning"` | Warning. |
| `"error"` | Error. |

### RowCounts

The row counts of a mapped parts import.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duplicate` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Duplicate rows. |
| `new` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | New parts. |
| `rejected` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Rejected rows. |
| `unchanged` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Unchanged parts. |
| `updated` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Updated parts. |

### LibraryRow

One library of `LibListResult`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `findings` | array of string | yes |  | Files and lines skipped, and other notes. |
| `generation` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) | yes |  | The manifest generation. |
| `id` | string | yes |  | The library ID. |
| `index` | string | yes |  | The index state (`fresh`, `rebuilt`, `failed: …`). |
| `key` | string | yes |  | The human key. |
| `licence` | string | yes |  | The default licence of its items. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | The display name. |
| `path` | string or `null` | no |  | The directory; `null` for a compiled-in library. |
| `tier` | string | yes |  | The tier (`system`, `community`, `company`, `user`). |
| `version` | string | yes |  | The library's version. |
| `writable` | boolean | yes |  | Whether it accepts writes. |

```text

```

|---|---|

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.lib-search-result/1`, schema [`ew.lib-search-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.lib-search-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.lib-search-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `hits` | array of [`LibHit`](#libhit) | yes |  | The hits, parts first. |

### LibHit

One hit of `LibSearchResult`: a part or another library item.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A part (`kind` is `part`).

   Shape: [`PartHitRow`](#parthitrow)

2. **Form 2**: A symbol, FnDef, form, macro or manufacturer.

   Shape: [`ItemHitRow`](#itemhitrow)

### ItemHitRow

A hit of another library item.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes |  | The item ID. |
| `key` | string | yes |  | The human key, empty when none. |
| `kind` | string | yes |  | `symbol`, `fndef`, `form`, `macro` or `manufacturer`. |
| `library` | string | yes |  | The library ID. |
| `library_key` | string | yes |  | The library's key. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | The name in every language, joined by " / ". |
| `rank_tier` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) | yes |  | 0 (no text), 1 exact key, 2 key prefix, 4 full text. |
| `status` | any JSON value | yes |  | The item status. |
| `tier` | string | yes |  | The library's tier. |
| `version` | string | yes |  | The item's version. |

### PartHitRow

A part hit.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | yes |  | The description in every language, joined by " / ". |
| `item` | string | yes |  | The item ID. |
| `kind` | string | yes |  | `part`. |
| `library` | string | yes |  | The library ID. |
| `library_key` | string | yes |  | The library's key. |
| `manufacturer` | string | yes |  | The manufacturer's name. |
| `part_kind` | string | yes |  | The part kind. |
| `part_number` | string | yes |  | The part number, verbatim. |
| `rank_tier` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) | yes |  | 0 (no text), 1 exact part number, 2 prefix, 3 trigram, 4 full text. |
| `status` | any JSON value | yes |  | The item status (`released`, or `{"deprecated": {"successor": …}}`). |
| `tier` | string | yes |  | The library's tier. |
| `version` | string | yes |  | The item's version. |
